snippet.description:
If Michigan doesn’t build data centers, other states will. But is that a good reason to race ahead? Michigan congressional candidate Will Lawrence and Vox’s Astead Herndon discuss why Lawrence wants a federal moratorium on data center construction and what’s at stake for workers and communities.

Listen wherever you get your podcasts, or watch here on YouTube.
